title: Pointed Modal Abelian Logic, Algebraically
summary: In this article, we investigate the pointed modal logic of reals. We first establish its relational (Kripke) semantics with bounded valuations in the Abelian l-group of real numbers with the distinguished negative constant -1. To study this logic algebraically, we introduce the variety of negatively pointed modal Abelian l-groups, in particular we focus on the strongly pointed members thereof.
